# teams_ip_phone_policy (Resource)

Manages the IPPhonePolicy policy via New-CsTeamsIPPhonePolicy / Get-CsTeamsIPPhonePolicy / Set-CsTeamsIPPhonePolicy / Remove-CsTeamsIPPhonePolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `allow_better_together` (String) Maps to the -AllowBetterTogether parameter.
- `allow_home_screen` (String) Maps to the -AllowHomeScreen parameter.
- `allow_hot_desking` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowHotDesking parameter.
- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `hot_desking_idle_timeout_in_minutes` (Number) Maps to the -HotDeskingIdleTimeoutInMinutes parameter.
- `search_on_common_area_phone_mode` (String) Maps to the -SearchOnCommonAreaPhoneMode parameter.
- `sign_in_mode` (String) Maps to the -SignInMode parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
